thread_lifecycle.without_parallel: core safe_ref.rs1-14 selects Rc/RefCell; Runtime/Context Send/Sync implementations are cfgparallel only. Construct/use/drop on the owned worker thread rather than move provider internals through host-neutral ports.
thread_lifecycle.with_parallel: safe_ref.rs5-14 selects Arc/Mutex; runtime/base.rs229-242 and context/base.rs132-140 provide unsafe Send/Sync behind runtime-global locking. Context::with121-128 holds that lock for the whole callback and refreshes stack top. This serializes runtime access; it is not parallel evaluation within one runtime or nonblocking scheduling.
thread_lifecycle.reentrancy: A host callback reentering Context::with on the same runtime encounters the already-held Mutex/RefCell path. Avoid runtime lock recursion; use same scoped Ctx or bounded staged host requests. No hang was executed.
thread_lifecycle.context_drop: context/base.rs9-36 frees with lock; parallel contended drop queues pointer in pending_free sender. raw.rs121-154 documents drain on later lock ownership or runtime drop; RawRuntime drop drains, clears opaque and frees VM. Do not claim a proven leak merely from queued frees; admission must bound contexts and reclamation backlog.
thread_lifecycle.affinity: parallel wrapper safety concerns serialized QuickJS state, not arbitrary host callbacks/foreign destructors or callback thread safety. Prefer fixed owned worker runtime and immutable request/result data; actual selected feature/callback/drop behavior needs platform proof.
thread_lifecycle.cache: Do not share raw live JS values/Script/Context across engines/realms or persist binary bytecode without engine/source/profile/ABI identity; request compilation lifecycle and cache byte quota are separate from library Send/Sync claims.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: parallel permits serialized cross-thread access; it does not provide concurrent VM work, bounded runtime lock waiting or host-callback affinity safety.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: One long evaluation holds runtime lock; another actor waits without a bounded admission outcome, or host callback recursively locks the same runtime.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Use shared JobRuntime admission, fixed worker ownership and bounded immutable handoff; no locks in realtime audio callback or document authority while waiting; enforce deadline/cancel at worker boundary.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.proof: Contention/reentry/cancel/shutdown/queued-drop tests, bounded reclamation counters, affinity checks and per-actor fairness. No observed deadlock claimed.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: Effect's actual compound-assignment rewrite violates the required evaluation-order-preserving compatibility seam for side-effectful targets.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.remediation: Real AST reference evaluation with temporary base/index exactly once, correct coercion/order and source mapping. Do not treat a lenient translator or changed JS engine as the remedy.
